'
Anchomomys' milleri
is an
extinct
primate
related to
lemuriforms
that lived in
Africa
during the early late
Eocene
. It was originally thought to be a member of the European genus
Anchomomys
, but was later aligned with the
djebelemurids
, although a new generic name needs to be assigned.
